info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Loan Application By Offer Id-spec
info.description: This API allows users to remove specific loan applications associated with a given offer ID, streamlining the management of loan data. Typically used by financial services or loan processing systems, it facilitates the deletion of outdated or erroneous applications, enhancing data integrity. Developers can invoke this endpoint to ensure that only relevant loan applications remain active in the system, allowing for efficient updates to loan-related resources. Use cases include cleaning up applications post-approval, rejections, or on user request.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a specified loan offer associated with a loan application. Ensure that the offer ID is valid and that you have the necessary permissions to perform this action.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to delete a specific loan offer associated with the loan application identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the correct offer identifier is included in the request body to properly execute the deletion.

204.description: Request completed successfully and the resource has been deleted.
